steps.name: DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN
steps.note: The launcher's sign-in is a Chromium browser whose GPU process draws into the browser process's window. DXMT refuses such cross-process swapchains unless told the driver supports them; Highball's Wine 11 engine (build 15+) does.

steps.text: Second-most-reported broken launcher on Whisky's tracker (freezes on logo). The launcher needs the Social Club redistributable which its installer bundles. If it freezes on the logo, try renderer d3dmetal and winetricks vcrun2019.

knownIssues.symptom: Installer sticks forever at 'Preparing to Install...'; if bypassed, the launcher shows 'The Rockstar Games Launcher failed to initialize!'
knownIssues.cause: verified 2026-08-26: the installer misses its service handshake and waits forever (files, VC++ and the service actually land), then Launcher.exe fails init after localisation on every renderer. CodeWeavers ships Rockstar fixes inside their Wine; this engine does not have them yet. Re-checked 2026-09-02 on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), M1 Pro, fresh bottle with ServicesPipeTimeout=60000 present before the session started: identical. The installer's own log (ProgramData\Rockstar Games\Launcher\installer_log.txt) shows both VC++ redists exit 0, 'RockstarService.exe install' exit 0, the uninstall registry keys written, then nothing; it never starts the service (sc query: STOPPED, exit 1077 never started). A manual 'sc start "Rockstar Service"' reaches RUNNING with the service logging its handshake subsystem up, and the installer stays parked at 'Preparing to Install...' regardless (12 minutes, twice). Re-tested 2026-09-02 on macOS 26.6.2: same install-time deadlock (the installer never requests the service start). On CrossOver 26.3's Wine the install completes and the service runs; the launcher then fails on its Direct3D 10.1 + Direct2D device, not on CEF: wined3d has no feature level, DXVK builds for macOS cannot serve it, D3DMetal ships no d3d10core, and DXMT 0.80 aborts in SwapDeviceContextState. With that method stubbed the launcher window appears, so the graphics half is a DXMT fix.
knownIssues.fix: none at the app level. Tracked upstream at Sikarugir-App/Sikarugir#258. Highball ships a fixed engine as soon as one exists.

knownIssues.symptom: Sign in or create account fails with 'Sorry, we are unable to handle your request at this time' and a code (#1.000.7 signing in, #1.500.7 creating an account)
knownIssues.cause: The Mac's clock. Rockstar's sign-in refuses a request whose clock is off, and the launcher reports it as a service error. Found 2026-09-08 on an M1 Pro whose date was right but whose time zone was not: sign-in and sign-up were refused for four days from the launcher, from Safari on the same Mac, and over a VPN and a phone hotspot, while the same account signed in from a phone on the same connection. Setting the Mac to take its time zone from its location fixed it, and the launcher signed in on the next attempt with no other change (auth status 200).
knownIssues.fix: Set the Mac's clock: System Settings > General > Date & Time, with 'Set time zone automatically using your current location' on. Then sign in again. If it still refuses, the account itself is fine on another device, so create or reset it at socialclub.rockstargames.com and retry.

lastVerified.result: dxmt + DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 on the Wine 11 engine: installer, service and launcher run, the 'Rockstar Games - Sign In' window renders, and signing in succeeds once the Mac's clock is right. Verified end to end 2026-09-08: signed in, the launcher reached Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced and started it. Bundled Wine 10 engine: the browser dies on a missing user32 export, no sign-in.

blocked.reason: Not on the bundled Wine 10 engine: the launcher's embedded browser (the Sign In window) dies there on a missing user32 export (IsWindowArranged), so it never shows the sign-in. It works on Highball's Wine 11 engine (CrossOver 26.3 base, build 15 or newer) with the cross-process browser fix (Wine bug 60263) and graphics mode DXMT: verified 2026-09-05 on an M1 Pro / macOS 26.6.2, the Sign In renders and is interactive. Available once that engine is installable from Highball.
